title: -6 (4-6) Dvayakārī (2-4)
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca [page 248] 248 SUPAṆṆA-SAṂYUTTA [XXX. 4-6. 4 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Jalābujānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ || la || Saṃsedajānaṃ || Opapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 4 Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti vācāya dvayakārī manasā dvayakārī || tassa sutaṃ hoti Opapātikā supaṇṇā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulāti || || 5 Tassa evaṃ hoti Ahovatāham kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā opapātikānam supaṇṇānam sahavyatam upapajjeyyanti || || So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā opapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjati || || 6 Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā opapātikānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || ||
